title: Data table
description: A small table that builds row by row on a glass card: a header, rows sliding up in turn, status chips popping in (Done/Live green, In review/Pending amber, Blocked red), then after a beat one row is picked out in the accent and the rest dim. For SaaS dashboards, checklists, plan comparisons and status boards. Over video by default.

columns.description: Column headings, left to right (the first column is the widest).

rows.description: One per row, cells separated by |. A cell in [brackets] is a status chip coloured by its word (done, live, shipped, paid: green; review, pending, scheduled, draft: amber; blocked, failed, overdue: red; anything else: the accent).

highlight.description: Row picked out in the accent after a beat while the others dim (0-based; -1: none).

plate.description: The card under the table: glass (translucent, the footage shows through), solid (the palette's surface) or none.
